script_text: Libra, Venus squares Saturn Monday, and an 8th House Full Moon shakes your shared finances. Venus in your 4th House squares Saturn in your 7th, straining love as home clashes with partnerships. Tuesday improves as Mercury in Scorpio trines Neptune in Pisces, sharpening money intuition. The Full Moon in Taurus hits your 8th House Wednesday, opposing the Sun in your 2nd House. This lunar peak triggers a release in intimacy and joint resources. By Thursday, Venus sextiles Jupiter in your 11th House, unlocking income and romance via friends. The weekend favors networking; your Air element lifts your spirit. Sunday favors signing contracts or launching a side hustle. Wednesday is your power day as the Full Moon illuminates your 8th House. Friday is your worst day as Venus squares Mars, sparking money fights. Review joint finances before signing anything this week. Follow for daily updates.
